Step: Confirm expected files and fields are present
Input: Current- and prior-year trial balance exports
Expected output: Pass/fail list of expected files and columns
Written rule?: Yes: list of expected file names and column headers
Possible failure: File missing, column renamed, wrong entity exported
Evidence kept: Schema-check log saved with the run
Data restrictions: Internal financial data; script runs locally, no AI at run time

Step: Validate reporting periods and control totals
Input: Both trial balance files; general ledger totals
Expected output: Period confirmed; trial balance totals tie to the general ledger
Written rule?: Yes: period must equal the reporting period; totals must tie
Possible failure: Wrong period, partial export, unposted entries
Evidence kept: Control-total report saved with the run
Data restrictions: Internal financial data; no AI at run time

Expected output: Variance by account, in dollars and percent
Written rule?: Yes: change = current year minus prior year; % = change / |prior year|
Possible failure: Divide-by-zero when prior year is 0; sign errors on credit balances
Evidence kept: Variance file plus script version / commit
Data restrictions: Internal financial data; no AI at run time

Expected output: List of accounts over threshold, ranked
Written rule?: Yes: approved policy (example: over $50,000 AND over 10%)
Evidence kept: Threshold value and approval reference in the run log
Proposed approach: Deterministic automation (threshold in one labeled parameter)
Data restrictions: Internal financial data; no AI at run time

Expected output: Transaction detail for each flagged account

Data restrictions: Internal financial data; no AI at run time
